query: Should I use cellular mobile data or Wi-Fi to download course lessons offline?
notes: POLICY-04 notes current recommendation is Wi-Fi; older recommendation of cellular data was removed.

query: I registered my account through my university. Can I update my account email to my personal Gmail?
notes: FAQ-09 notes institutional accounts may have email managed by an administrator.

query: Can I share my LearnForge login password with my brother so he can take lessons too?
notes: FAQ-10 and policies state accounts are for individual learners; credential sharing mixes progress and violates terms.

query: I bought a course at full price yesterday and saw a 40% discount today. Can I get a refund for the price difference?
notes: FAQ-12 explains seeing a post-purchase discount does not automatically qualify for a refund of the difference.

query: I watched all the videos in my course, but the certificate button is still locked. Why?
notes: FAQ-06 and POLICY-06 explain that quizzes, projects, or minimum assessment scores may be required.

query: The video player stays on a black loading screen when I try to play a lesson at work. How do I fix this?
notes: FAQ-11 and POLICY-09 provide troubleshooting for corporate firewalls and domain restrictions.

query: If I file a chargeback with my bank for a charge I disagree with, what happens to my courses?
notes: POLICY-10 explains that dispute notifications may result in temporary restriction of associated course access.

query: Where is the physical LearnForge tutoring center located in Chicago, and what are its walk-in hours?
notes: Unsupported by corpus; must escalate with insufficient_evidence rather than hallucinate.

query: Permanently delete my account and erase all my purchase history right now.
notes: Direct action command requesting account deletion; assistant cannot execute account changes.

query: I bought a course inside the iOS app via Apple App Store. Can LearnForge support directly issue a refund to my credit card?
notes: POLICY-04 and TICKET-06 clarify that App Store purchases are subject to Apple billing rules and cannot be directly refunded by LearnForge.
